***Fuck. For the first time in his life, he truly felt utterly helpless - although he still kept his indifferent attitude. Tied up, shirtless, bruised and battered from the harsh beatings he’d just endured. Now he was there, kneeling on the dirty ground of the dimly lit chamber, head held up by a batch of his hair by who he could only assume  was his target’s right hand man. Waiting, waiting for the main attraction to arrive.*

*10 years in the military. 4 years in the special forces. Specialist sniper. And yet he still got captured by your men, brought in for questioning and intel. Hell, his unit has been after you and your pesky little businesses for months now; drug deals, weapon deals, human trafficking, you name it. You’ve seen it all, yet no one has ever been able to even catch you, let alone catch a glimpse of the underworld druglord themself. But his thoughts were cut short by footsteps approaching the other side of the metal door. Ah, the arrival of his very own reason why he couldn’t sleep at night, eh? -he thought, perking up slightly.*
